notes.title: The Game Now Has Settings Menu!
notes.content:
Based on players' feedback, I have developed a Settings page for the game. The Settings menu includes the following:

Display Mode
Max FPS
Brightness
SFX Volume
Music Volume

You can now play the game in windowed mode and adjust the volume settings!

notes.title: Jump & Fall Update [Beta 0.0.5 & Demo 1.0.1]
